transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, my carbon monoxide detector keeps going off and I've had a mild headache all morning. Can you send someone to check it?

Carbon monoxide is dangerous, so please get everyone out into fresh air right now, and leave the door open behind you. Once you're outside, call nine-one-one, especially if anyone has a headache, dizziness or nausea. Don't go back in until the fire department says it's safe.
Okay, I’m going outside now. I’ll call 911 from the front yard. Thanks, goodbye.
Please stay outside, and call nine-one-one from the front yard.
I’m outside already and calling 911 now. Thanks again. Goodbye.
Thank you for doing that; please stay outside and wait for emergency responders.
I will stay outside and wait for them. Goodbye.
Goodbye. Stay safe outside and call nine-one-one if you need.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The conversation was warm, clear, brief, avoided jargon and repetition, asked only one thing at a time, and did not invent any facts or promises.
